supportingSubcard: T06 dependency review for the L0 Windows helper
reviewStatus: dependency_resolution_and_metadata_review_complete; Windows helper linked and passed read-only startup/capture smoke
parentTaskStatus: T06 remains not_started; this narrow prerequisite does not claim T06 completion

design.rationale: The helper uses the frozen stdin/stdout JSON-lines protocol, so its Windows ABI is separate from Electron's MSVC process ABI. The local machine has no Visual Studio/MSVC linker; the isolated Rust GNU toolchain successfully linked the actual x64 helper, and a read-only startup/capture smoke verified its READY process identity and clean shutdown before T02 acceptance.

dependencies.name: serde_json
dependencies.use: bounded JSON-lines protocol parsing and output

dependencies.name: sha2
dependencies.use: content chunk and whole-object SHA-256 validation

dependencies.name: windows-sys
dependencies.use: narrow windows-rs raw Win32 bindings for clipboard, foreground/process identity, key state, and SendInput

reviewFindings: windows-sys is in the official microsoft/windows-rs project and matches the direct C-style Win32 API boundary; it is smaller than the typed windows umbrella crate for this binary.
cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked resolved 24 registry packages (25 total packages including the local helper); all declared MSRVs are satisfied by Rust 1.99.0.

Cargo metadata provides SPDX license expressions for every resolved registry package. The notable expressions are memchr's Unlicense OR MIT, unicode-ident's (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0, and zmij's MIT; see resolvedRegistryPackages for the complete set.
cargo check --all-targets --locked type-checked the helper and its Windows dependencies on the x86_64-pc-windows-gnu host; this does not link or run the helper.
The release helper imports only Windows system DLLs; helper artifact SHA-256 is recorded in docs/evidence/T02/verification.json.
